Container.Name: Vibe
Container.Overview: All-in-one self-hosted media server: movies, TV, music, audiobooks, podcasts, photos, live TV, Xtream Codes / M3U IPTV with EPG and catch-up, DVR, and server-driven branding for the web, phone and TV apps. Open the WebUI and follow the setup wizard.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, artwork, branding, logs and backups. Keep on the cache pool.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media share. Add libraries under /media/... in the setup wizard.

Config.Name: Transcode
Config.Description: Scratch space for streaming segments. /tmp/... is in RAM on Unraid; use a cache pool folder if RAM is tight.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id Vibe runs as (99 = nobody, the Unraid default for shares).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: For DVR schedules and the guide, e.g. Europe/London.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU
Config.Description: Hardware transcoding: enter /dev/dri (needs the Intel GPU TOP or Radeon TOP plugin), then pick VA-API or QSV in Admin -> Settings -> Transcoding. Leave empty if you have no GPU.

Config.Name: TMDB API key
Config.Description: Optional; can also be set in Admin -> Settings.
